buttons.description: Quick prompt buttons shown in the band above the prompt, in order.

title.description: Fallback label, used for languages missing from titles.

text.description: Single prompt text submitted as the user's own words, for every language.

texts.description: Per-language prompt text, e.g. { "ru": "Покажи подсказку", "en": "Show the hint" }. Overrides text; default is the label in the active language.

command.description: Slash command name — pressing submits /<command> instead of text.
